_comment: LOCAL SMOKE-TEST CONFIG — not part of the Pressure Test service family. Drives the local `claude` and `codex` CLIs instead of OpenRouter, so a full multi-round run can be exercised end-to-end (stream, UI, convergence, severity movement) without an API key and without spending anything. The cli adapter reports no token usage, so runs from this config have NO cost table — that is expected here and is exactly why it isn't a shipped config. Run: node orchestrate.mjs --config agents.clitest.json --task "..." --rounds 2
